sample_unit: simulated physician decisions (13 questions x 1000 repetitions)

links.outcome: Change in GPT-4 simulated physician choices when patient and physician demographics varied
links.effect: Simulated physicians favored patients with demographics similar to their own, with most pairwise comparisons significant (P<.05). Nondescript physicians favored White, male, and young patients.
links.quote: Overall, simulated physicians consistently demonstrated racial, gender, age, political affiliation, and sexual orientation bias in clinical decision-making.

screen.reason: Evaluates inherent demographic and political biases in simulated clinical triage decisions made by GPT-4 across diverse physician personas without testing a specific safeguard or deployment practice.
